Salvageist provenance
--------------------
Source: https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
Retrieved 2026-09-21 from Kenney's official distribution.
This folder contains nine selected source recordings: impactMetal_heavy,
impactPlate_heavy and impactSoft_heavy, takes 000, 001 and 002 of each.
The original distribution is Ogg Vorbis. Derived WAV files in the parent
directory are edited/layered by MechanicalAudioArt; WAV does not restore
information discarded in the original compressed recordings.

MechanicalAudioArt creates missing derivatives only. Existing authored audio
is never regenerated on startup or silently overwritten by this command.
